steps: Library shuttle from the Administration Building to Seoul Nat'l Univ. Station: 3 buses (was 2).
Late-night shuttle leaves Bldg 302 at 23:40, 00:15, 00:50, 01:25, 02:00, every 35 minutes.
The late-night route now also stops at the Open-air Theater (노천강당).
